scope: Arithmetic witnesses only; the contour and uniform proof are in the lemma.

checks.name: radial_margin
checks.purpose: Original squared diagonal margin.

checks.name: ordinate_square
checks.purpose: Common-line geometry for the polynomial kernel.

checks.name: ordinate_less_than_one
checks.purpose: Every node ordinate has modulus less than one.

checks.name: contour_holomorphic
checks.purpose: The entire union of disks avoids all possible poles of f_u.

checks.name: kernel_factor
checks.purpose: Every boundary-to-node factor is smaller than 2R.

checks.name: adaptive_radius
checks.purpose: r_0=N/(8n) has room for regular-radius approximation.

checks.name: log_ratio_coefficient
checks.purpose: Scalar logarithm bound in the reflected-weight ratio.

checks.name: R_over_sigma_squared
checks.purpose: R/sigma<9.

checks.name: log_two_witness
checks.purpose: The positive exponential series proves log(2)<7/10.

checks.name: density_rate
checks.purpose: Upper envelope for phi(1/384).

checks.name: log_nine_witness
checks.purpose: The positive exponential series proves log(9)<3.

checks.name: onset_polynomial_cost
checks.purpose: 3+2 log(n)<=n/320 starts at n=8192.

checks.name: onset_monotonicity
checks.purpose: Derivative stays positive for every n>=8192.

checks.name: total_amplitude_rate
checks.purpose: Contour and polynomial costs meet the required amplitude rate.

checks.name: anchor_diagonal
checks.purpose: r_x>=1 and W_x=1.

checks.name: correction_coefficient_squared
checks.purpose: sqrt(21)/(24 sigma)<2.

checks.name: correction_at_onset
checks.purpose: Uniform correction-to-guaranteed-response bound at the onset.

checks.name: correction_budget
checks.purpose: At least one half of the guaranteed response remains.

checks.name: squared_rate
checks.purpose: Required squared exponent.
